direction.meaning: A citation encountered in the wild spelled 'E5-2394' should be resolved to the record stored under 'E5-2394Filed'.
direction.reverse_reason: 'E5-2394' dereferences nowhere. Observed 2026-08-31 (headers saved in witnesses/): 404 at the Federal Register API and a soft 404 at GovInfo. Rewriting a stored 'E5-2394Filed' to 'E5-2394' converts a fetchable identifier into a dead one. The fused spelling is the lossless identity and is kept.

strength.one_document_basis: The print page and the API record agree on title, agency, docket, date and page; the print page carries the fused token in its own colophon.
strength.unfused_number_basis: No witness in this evidence home shows the string 'E5-2394' standing alone as this document's number. The inference rests on the colophon template '[FR Doc. {number} Filed {date}; {time}]', held invariant by the control colophon on the same page (E5-2414), which fixes 'Filed' as template literal and leaves 'E5-2394' as the only possible {number}. Corroborated by the vacancy of E5-2394 between live neighbours E5-2393 and E5-2395.

differences: Both witnesses agree exactly on the fusion: '2394' and 'Filed' are adjacent with no separator in either.

They disagree on the dash codepoint: print uses EN DASH U+2013 ('E5–2394Filed'), the API raw text uses HYPHEN-MINUS U+002D ('E5-2394Filed'). The API's document_number field, and every identifier derived from it, uses U+002D.

notes: Causal reading, offered as the best explanation and not as a witnessed fact: the colophon line is generated by GPO composition from a template. Had the template lost the space, every colophon in the issue would be fused; the control colophon on the same page, in the same font and size, has its space. So the loss is per-document, in this document's composition source. Downstream, GPO's metadata extractor read the document number back off the composed colophon by splitting on whitespace and captured 'E5-2394Filed'. That is why the fused token appears identically in the print page, the GovInfo granule id, and the Federal Register API: they are not three independent observations but one defect and two derivations of it. Counting them as three witnesses would overstate the evidence. ADDENDUM 2026-08-31 (post-review): transport statuses for the vacancy corroboration are now witnessed by saved headers (E5-2393 200, E5-2395 200, E5-2396 404, E5-2394 404). The rendered PNG is a viewing aid, not a witness: 6 witnesses, 1 aid, 8 probe files.
